name: field-closure-foundation
objective: Reconcile field-only scope, canonical contracts and trustworthy field verification entry points before feature closure.
truthOwner: Product Truth defines scope; Identity owns auth/session, Workforce owns field profile/assignment/readiness, DSH owns operational truth, WLT owns financial truth.

tasks.objective: Make app-field verification entry points execute all required field-specific tests in addition to the generic mobile runtime contract.
tasks.currentProblem: The declared app-field test script runs only the generic mobile runtime contract while a readiness transport test exists separately.
tasks.requiredChange: Wire field-specific test files into the canonical app-field test command or an equally authoritative gate referenced by CI and this closure plan.
tasks.targetState: A green field test gate means required app-field behavioral/contract tests actually executed on that SHA.
tasks.action: Update the owning test script/package configuration and CI binding; do not duplicate tests in surface-local ad-hoc commands.
mustNotChange: Do not expand tests into unrelated application journeys.
Do not weaken existing mobile runtime contract checks.
Do not treat this package as CI truth.
acceptanceCriteria: The canonical field test command executes the field-specific tests and fails when one fails.
Generic mobile configuration checks still run or remain an explicit required sibling gate.
CI/evidence records the exact resulting SHA.
tasks.rollback: Revert the focused test-wiring change if it breaks unrelated scripts; do not delete field tests.
tasks.commitBoundary: One focused foundation commit after field verification commands pass.

tasks.objective: Enforce the field-only functional scope matrix against current Product Truth and current code.
tasks.currentProblem: The prior package treated the five-surface validator envelope as if every surface and 107 journeys were field scope.
tasks.requiredChange: Keep structural validator fields but mark unrelated surfaces/sections with evidence and use affectedSurfaces subsets for executable units.
tasks.targetState: No implementation task exists solely because another app exists in the repository.
tasks.action: Reconcile Product Truth, current contracts/source and the new COVERAGE matrix before each unit starts; conflicts block rather than broaden scope.
mustNotChange: Do not change Product Truth from this package.
Do not add captain dispatch/COD/checkout scope without new current authority.
Do not convert derived support into policy.
acceptanceCriteria: app-captain remains excluded under current Product Truth.
Client/partner/control participation is limited to exact field-originated readback.
Strict package validation passes without broadening functional scope.
tasks.rollback: Revert planning-only drift; never change runtime to satisfy a planning artifact.
tasks.commitBoundary: Same focused foundation commit or package-only reconciliation commit.
